title: Great Southern Bancorp, Inc. announces quarterly dividend of $0.43 per common share
summary: SPRINGFIELD, Mo., Sept. 16, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- The Board of Directors of Great Southern Bancorp, Inc. (NASDAQ:GSBC), the holding company for Great Southern Bank, declared a $0.43 per common share dividend for the third quarter of the calendar year ending December 31, 2026. The dividend will be payable on October 14, 2026, to stockholders of record on September 28, 2026.
